Hi Kelly — thanks for the clear list. I put together a short baseline and attached a simple workbook (RI_Rerank_Ratecard_v1.xlsx) plus a sample volumes CSV so your finance team can swap numbers quickly. Summary below; full detail in the attachment.

High-level billing model (hosted API, baseline):
- Reranker ("scoring" multiple candidates): base per-query request fee + per-scored-item fee.
  - Base per-query: $0.0005 (covers routing, KV/cache lookup, minimal token overhead)
  - Per-scored-item: $0.0008 per candidate scored (applies to each candidate the model evaluates)
  - Example: scoring 50 candidates = $0.0005 + 50 * $0.0008 = $0.0405 per query

- Classifier (single-call classification): billed per call — flat $0.0020 per call for the baseline hosted SKU.

Why the difference: rerankers evaluate multiple candidates and incur proportional compute for each scored item (KV cache and attention work scales), whereas classifiers are a single forward pass.

Volume discounts / committed tiers (hosted):
- 0–5M monthly queries: baseline rates above.
- 5M–50M: 15% off per-scored-item fee (can be applied to base per-query on large commitments).
- 50M+: negotiate custom slab with further discounts + rate-stable commit.

Other notes:
- We charge per-scored-item regardless of number returned. Caching (prefix/KV) can meaningfully reduce per-query cost if you have repeat candidates; we can model cache hit assumptions separately.
- For batched/collated calls (you score many queries together) we can recommend continuous batching config that lowers effective per-item cost — see tab: "batching impact" in the workbook.

Next steps I suggest: you send a representative daily sample (even a histogram: percent queries scoring 1/5/10/50 candidates) and we’ll run a cost projection. If you want, Aditya and Ben can propose a trial commit that includes an intro discount for first three months.

Thanks — Hannah

Hi Kelly — quick answers and a counter-offer from pricing:

1) Partial scoring / early-stop: we bill for actual scored candidates. If your pipeline early-stops after 10 candidates, you’re charged for 10 scored items only. The attachment includes a worked example of early-stop savings.
2) Base per-query fee: applies to each distinct API call. If that call performs zero scoring (e.g., a pure classifier call routed to a classification model) we still apply the base per-query fee unless the call is a pure embed-only or health-check call (we can toggle routing exemptions for extreme volumes).
3) Multi-label classifier: billed as a single classifier call. The model does additional heads internally but we treat that as one request for metering.

Discount / commit counter: we can do a 20% discount on per-scored-item fees for the first 6 months with a 12-month term if you commit to a guaranteed 8M queries/mo minimum. Caveats: discounts apply to per-scored-item line only (not to base per-query), and we require a quarterly reconciliation report.

If that looks OK, Ben will open a deal record and Marissa will kick off trial provisioning. We can also run a quick cost-sensitivity model if you send the histogram Hannah requested.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
